observations: Single rectangular glass tabletop leaning against a wall, no legs or stand visible, matching seller's statement that the base is excluded.
Surface has an etched floral/butterfly decorative pattern in the center.
Four metal corner brackets/caps are fitted at each corner, apparently for attaching to a frame or legs.
Glass appears dark/black tinted, edges are beveled with cut corners.
Heavy glare and reflection across the surface make it hard to see fine scratches, chips, or cracks.
No brand, maker's mark, or thickness label is visible anywhere in the photo.
Item is resting on a rough concrete floor outdoors, not staged for close inspection.

identity.kind: rectangular black glass center table top (legs not included)

risks.risk: Hidden cracks or chips obscured by glare/reflection
risks.proof: Close-up photos of each edge and corner taken in diffuse, non-glare light

risks.proof: Close-up photo of each bracket from the top and underside

proof_requests: Clear, non-glare close-ups of all four edges and corners
A photo with a tape measure showing length, width, and glass thickness
Close-up of any tempering stamp or manufacturer mark on an edge
Close-up of the underside and brackets to check for rust or looseness
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a glass center table top without legs, so it can be priced at worst case (ordinary, unverified-tempered glass, unknown size, possible undetected damage) while flagging the specific proofs that could raise its value.
